FAQ

Straight answers.

I can start within 48 hours. Discovery call → audit → kickoff. First ads live in 7-10 days after assets. I keep slots limited to 4 active clients to maintain quality.
I work from ₹30k/month ad spend up to ₹5L+/month. Minimum retainer starts at ₹25k. I’m transparent: if your offer/budget isn’t ready, I’ll tell you.
Yes. Professional shoots, graphic design, video editing, UGC scripts — all in-house. That’s why I can test 15-20 variants in week one while agencies wait on freelancers.
Agencies have account managers. You get me — strategist, media buyer, shooter, editor. One operator, full stack. No layers, no delays, direct WhatsApp. Plus I automate what agencies do manually.
No one can guarantee ROAS — platforms change. What I guarantee: daily optimization, transparent reporting, kill/scale discipline, and 14-day test with clear go/no-go. 200+ clients trust that process.
